messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up — build partner 'CloudForge' co-hosted webinar confirmed for July 19. Need owners for speaker rotation, live lab seats, fallback video, and swag manifest.

Rahul Iyer: I'll coordinate speakers. Can we do a 45min session + 20min hands-on lab?

Bea Torres: 45/20 works. For APAC we'll repeat the lab at a later local time. Who's doing the lab infra?

Derek Wu: Infra can spin up a sandbox cluster and limit concurrency. Request: token-based access that expires in 24h.

Sam (events): I'll add registration fields: name, email, ship-swag? checkbox, and session ID. Need opt-in for shipping.

Nina Park: Good. Rahul, get speaker bios (<=75 words) and headshots (square) by 7/1 please.

Rahul Iyer: Noted. Also, partner wants to reuse recording externally — ok with attribution?

Bea Torres: Fine if partner credits Redwood and links back to the marketplace listing. I'll draft a short license blurb.

Derek Wu: Fallback plan: prerecorded 6-min clip from Redwood (MP4, 720p). I'll record and drop link by 7/10.

Sam (events): Swag plan: partner sends t-shirts, Redwood sends sticker kits + quickstart card. Shipping windows target: US arrive by 7/14, APAC by 7/15. Need SKU list and customs values.

CourierBot: Reminder: include HS codes and commercial invoice. Undelivered items held 21 days then donated unless flagged.

Nina Park: Assign Charlotte to finalize courier and labels. Use receiver name: "CloudForge Events (attn: Hana)" for APAC.

Rahul Iyer: For the lab, let's include a small CLI snippet in the runbook to swap to hosted endpoint during live handoff.

Derek Wu: Suggest snippet: export REDWOOD_TOKEN=<TOKEN>; redwood-cli demo --model redwood-lite --input sample.txt. We'll add TTL note.

Bea Torres: Marketing timeline: slides due 7/5, rehearsal 7/17, final sign-off 7/18. Embargo release scheduled 7/19 16:00 PT. Partners get 48h review.

Sam (events): AV note: enable live captions and record with captions file. We'll have an AV tech in greenroom.

Nina Park: Final owners: Rahul (speakers), Derek (infra + fallback), Bea (press & license), Sam (registration + swag pickup), Charlotte (courier). Reconvene next Wed for a go/no-go.

CourierBot: Tracking reminder set for 7/13-7/15 pickups.

Bea Torres: One more — legal asked to see any comparative claims in slides; please flag and route by 7/3.

Rahul Iyer: Will do. Thanks team. :sparkles:
